title: Bosun Realm 14: Tactician Contract v1
description: Machine-readable delta schema contract for Tactician (Realm 14), extending Archetype Dual-Track Telemetry with realm-specific payload attributes.

sport_type.description: Athletic discipline or game tactical category (e.g., sailing, cycling, running, chess).

split_metrics.description: Structured segment split times, power numbers, and pace statistics.

monte_carlo_preset.description: Tactical route or performance Monte Carlo simulation scenario preset.
